dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: No distinct horizontal bands are visible; the greater and median coverts exhibit broad pale edgings rather than discrete bars.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; thick, sharp pale white boundaries are clearly visible along the edges of the folded flight feathers against the dark grey body.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the dark grey of the crown transitions into the patterned mantle with a soft, blurred boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white scalloping across the entire dorsal surface caused by high-contrast wide pale margins on individual feathers.
